# Reviewed, intentional deviations between this build's nke-kubeadm-distro
# .deb and the production S3 golden manifests in this directory. See
# README.md for the format and the review rule. Every non-comment line must
# carry a " #" (space, then hash) reason — the parser rejects any that do
# not.
#
# removed/added/mode take a path OR a glob (path.Match semantics: "*"/"?"
# never cross a "/", so no "/**" is needed): one glob line can cover drift
# whose exact path is version-specific, e.g.
#   removed /usr/lib/nke/k8s-matrix/*/amd64/containerd-*-linux-amd64.tar.gz
# instead of one literal line per Kubernetes patch. A glob directive counts
# as used once it matches at least one entry in the relevant comparison.
#
# Any directive may take an "optional " prefix (e.g.
#   optional added /usr/lib/nke/k8s-matrix/*/amd64/k8s-base-container-images_*.tgz
# ) to mean: apply it when it matches, same as any other line, but do not
# treat matching nothing as unused. This is for per-version asymmetries a
# glob alone can't express — e.g. the production 1.36.3 package ships no
# k8s-base-container-images_*.tgz while 1.34.2 and 1.35.3 do, so the line
# above is needed for 1.36.3's comparison but would look like a stale no-op
# for the other two. "optional" is not a general escape from allowlist rot:
# use it only for a real per-version asymmetry, and say which version(s) the
# line exists for in its reason.
#
# Currently empty: the debs `make debs` produces today already differ from
# the golden manifests (Depends, Conflicts, and the .kubelet-keep
# placeholders — see README.md "Known drift"), but that drift has not been
# reviewed and allowlisted yet. `make contract-check` reports it as an
# advisory warning until it is. Populating this file happens together with
# the layout change tracked in package W2, when the drift becomes
# deliberate rather than incidental.
